title: ModelProfile
description: Type-validation schema for model profiles, derived from the Rust ModelProfile struct. The payload is content-addressed by digest; profile_id is human-readable metadata, not the authoritative trust anchor.

profile_id.description: Human-readable profile identifier used for aliases/UI. The profile digest remains authoritative.

model_id.description: Concrete model identifier the relay dispatches to the provider API (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6).
